LM_BridgeLeaf.pivot: ORIGIN = PIVOT (trunnion line at the heel, deck top level). Axis = Blender X = Unreal Y. Open by pitching the tip up (Unreal +pitch; Blender rotation_euler.x negative). Real DuSable leaves open to ~80 deg.
LM_BridgeLeaf.pair: second leaf: same pivot height, rotated 180 deg about Z with its origin 60 m from the first along the leaf axis; tips meet at 30 m
LM_BridgeLeaf.counterweight: y 0.4..6.0 m behind the pivot, z -1.4..-7.0 (keep it inside the abutment pit)

LM_BridgeRailing10.pivot: railing start, base centreline (0,0,0); runs to y = -10 (Unreal +X 1000 cm); posts at 0, 5, 10 m
LM_BridgeRailing10.tiling: repeat every 10 m; end posts coincide when tiled

LM_BridgeTenderHouse.pivot: ground centre (0,0,0); relief faces at y = -4 / +4 (Unreal +X / -X): face them along the roadway
LM_BridgeTenderHouse.placement: one at each corner of the bridge, beside the leaf heel (outside the 28 m deck), e.g. x = +/-18 m from the road axis

LM_BuckinghamFountain.pivot: fountain centre on the ground (0,0,0); place at the plan point (731.6, -1300.15) with no rotation
LM_BuckinghamFountain.sea_horses: 4 pairs (8) on the diagonal bastions at radius 29.4 m (OSM artwork nodes), verdigris
LM_BuckinghamFountain.notes: pool = four lobes r 25.8 m centred 16.9 m out + square bastions at (+/-30.5, +/-30.5) (OSM); jets: LM_BuckinghamJets

LM_BuckinghamJets.pivot: same origin as LM_BuckinghamFountain: place both at the same transform and toggle this one
LM_BuckinghamJets.notes: translucent spray shapes on M_WaterJet (use a two-sided translucent/additive material): centre core + spray sheath, 20 lower-ring + 16 middle-ring + 8 upper jets, 8 sea-horse spouts, cascades off all three lips

LM_BuckinghamPlaza.pivot: plan (731.6, -1300.15) = the fountain's centre, on the ground (LM_BuckinghamFountain / Jets go at the same point)
LM_BuckinghamPlaza.notes: pink paver plaza (octagon + N/S necks + arms to Columbus Dr and toward Lake Shore Dr), lawn ring and hoop fence round the pool, 4 pavilions with copper roofs, boxwood hedges, lamp standards
LM_BuckinghamPlaza.frame: plan-local (x east, y north) turned -90 deg: place in Unreal at the site origin with NO rotation

LM_CentennialWheel_Frame.pivot: ground point under the hub (0,0,0); hub centre at (0,0,30.8) m
LM_CentennialWheel_Frame.notes: wheel plane = Blender XZ (Unreal YZ); back legs rake toward Blender +Y (Unreal -X); platform 46 x 40 m

LM_CentennialWheel_Gondola.pivot: HANGER PIVOT (0,0,0) = the rotor's gondola axle; cabin hangs to z = -3.2 m
LM_CentennialWheel_Gondola.size_note: cabin 2.6 m (Blender X) x 2.0 m (Y) x 2.25 m, glass band 1.2 m
LM_CentennialWheel_Gondola.placement: for each k: position = hub + R_rotor(angle) * attachment_k, rotation = world upright (do not inherit rotor roll)

LM_CentennialWheel_Rotor.pivot: HUB CENTRE (0,0,0). Place at frame origin + (0,0,30.8) m (Unreal Z +3080 cm). Spins about Blender Y = Unreal X (roll).

gondola_attachment.blender_offset_from_hub_m: (R sin(2 pi k/42), 0, -R cos(2 pi k/42)), k = 0 at the bottom

LM_CentennialWheel_Rotor.notes: 21 main spoke pairs (LED strips on M_Light) + crossing tension rods; gondola axles on M_Steel

LM_CloudGate.pivot: base centre (0,0,0); stands on its two feet at x = +/-7 m
LM_CloudGate.long_axis: Blender X (Unreal Y); the long sides face -Y/+Y (Unreal +X/-X)
LM_CloudGate.notes: analytic smooth surface, smooth normals; M_MirrorSteel metallic 1 roughness 0.03

LM_CloudGatePlaza.pivot: plan (369.8, -538.7) = Cloud Gate's centre, on the ground; LM_CloudGate stands at (0, 0, 0.45) m on the deck
LM_CloudGatePlaza.notes: granite plaza (3 steps up) with balustrades, real step flights and ramps, perimeter planters; street-level McCormick Tribune Plaza with the rink outline; Chase Promenade and the Washington / Madison walks
LM_CloudGatePlaza.frame: plan-local (x east, y north) turned -90 deg: place in Unreal at the site origin with NO rotation

LM_CloudGatePlazaSteps.collision: NONE: the treads are visual; LM_CloudGatePlaza holds a hidden ramp under each flight so the car can drive up them
LM_CloudGatePlazaSteps.frame: plan-local (x east, y north) turned -90 deg: place in Unreal at the site origin with NO rotation

LM_NavyPierBallroom.pivot: plan (1496.0, 451.0) on the ground (same as LM_NavyPierDeck)
LM_NavyPierBallroom.frame: plan-local (x east, y north) turned -90 deg: place in Unreal at the site origin with NO rotation

LM_NavyPierBuildings.pivot: plan (1496.0, 451.0) on the ground (same as LM_NavyPierDeck)
LM_NavyPierBuildings.notes: buildings keep between the plan's pier roads (y 406.4..496.4); Festival Hall's real north wing (to y 514) is cut back so the north drive stays continuous
LM_NavyPierBuildings.frame: plan-local (x east, y north) turned -90 deg: place in Unreal at the site origin with NO rotation

LM_NavyPierDeck.pivot: plan (1496.0, 451.0) (headhouse west facade, pier centreline) on the ground; z 0 = plan ground
LM_NavyPierDeck.deck: real outline x 1496..2423 (929 m), y 383..521.5 (138.5 m) at the west, 91 m at the east end; dock walls to z -7.0
LM_NavyPierDeck.notes: east of the plan edge: north drive (Grand Ave lanes) to the turning circle, south promenade with tree pits, railings, lamps, East End Plaza flagpoles; inside the plan only dock walls under the roads + central paving
LM_NavyPierDeck.frame: plan-local (x east, y north) turned -90 deg: place in Unreal at the site origin with NO rotation

LM_NavyPierHeadhouse.pivot: ground centre (0,0,0); entrance facade at y = -14.5 (Unreal +X)
LM_NavyPierHeadhouse.connect: back wall at y = +12: place LM_NavyPierShed rotated 180 deg about Z with its origin at y = +12 to run the pier toward +Y

LM_NavyPierShed.pivot: deck top at the module's start edge, pier centreline (0,0,0); module runs to y = -60 (Unreal +X 6000 cm)
LM_NavyPierShed.tiling: repeat every 60 m along -Y (Unreal +X); end walls are closed and coincide back-to-back when tiled
LM_NavyPierShed.notes: set the lake surface ~1.5-2.5 m below the deck; lamps on M_Light

LM_PolkBrosJets.frame: plan-local (x east, y north) turned -90 deg: place in Unreal at the site origin with NO rotation

LM_PolkBrosPark.pivot: plan (1496.0, 451.0) on the ground (same as LM_NavyPierDeck)
LM_PolkBrosPark.frame: plan-local (x east, y north) turned -90 deg: place in Unreal at the site origin with NO rotation

conventions.units: metres in Blender/GLB; Unreal imports as centimetres
conventions.axes: Blender (x, y, z) -> Unreal (x, -y, z) (glTF import, verified): Blender +X = Unreal +X = plan north; site assets are plan-frame, placed unrotated
conventions.origin: centred on the origin, standing on z = 0, except where 'pivot' says otherwise

assembly.cloud_gate: LM_CloudGatePlaza at the bean site origin (ground); LM_CloudGate at +0.45 m on its deck, no rotation (long axis north-south)
assembly.buckingham: LM_BuckinghamPlaza, LM_BuckinghamFountain, LM_BuckinghamJets all at the fountain site origin, no rotation

centennial_wheel.where: plan (1684.4, 458.0) on Pier Park (OSM), wheel plane north-south (Unreal X-Z), axle east-west
centennial_wheel.frame: LM_CentennialWheel_Frame at P (deck surface under the hub)
centennial_wheel.rotor: LM_CentennialWheel_Rotor at P + (0, 0, 30.8) m = Unreal Z +3080 cm; animate about the Unreal Y axis (axle)
centennial_wheel.gondolas: 42 x LM_CentennialWheel_Gondola, k = 0..41: world pos = hub + (2660 sin(2 pi k/42), 0, -2660 cos(2 pi k/42)) cm (Unreal), kept upright; k = 0 hangs over the boarding deck (z 1.0 m)

assembly.navy_pier: LM_NavyPierDeck, LM_NavyPierBuildings, LM_NavyPierBallroom, LM_PolkBrosPark, LM_PolkBrosJets all at the pier site origin (plan (1496.0, 451.0), headhouse west facade on the pier centreline), no rotation

bascule_bridge.leaf_a: LM_BridgeLeaf at pivot A (deck top height), spanning +X in Unreal
bascule_bridge.leaf_b: LM_BridgeLeaf rotated 180 deg yaw, pivot 60 m from A along the bridge axis; tips meet mid-river
bascule_bridge.open: pitch each leaf up about its own origin (0..80 deg)
bascule_bridge.tender_houses: 4 x LM_BridgeTenderHouse, about 18 m either side of the road axis, 4.5 m behind each pivot (on the abutments), relief faces along the roadway
bascule_bridge.railings: LM_BridgeRailing10 continues the leaf railings along the approaches (x = +/-13.7 m from the axis, base on the 0.2 m sidewalk)
